descriptor.scene: A CLIMB INTO MORNING SKY is the subject. Vast warm dawn sky fills the frame. The winged block-tower startup climbs through its upper LEFT third, wings wide, tilted into ascent, trailing two soft paper-warm strokes; IGNORE THE SIZE AND PLACEMENT IN THE SUPPLIED PLATE, here it is airborne and one-fifth the frame's height. Far below at the bottom edge, tiny, the plain shut door stands alone in a low ordinary wall on a rooftop, rendered exactly one state, the master shut leaf, a small warm light glowing along its bottom crack. Ninety percent of the frame is sky. Keep the lower right calm for the caption card.

prompt: Picture-book spread painted in the warm editorial ink-and-wash register of the FIRST reference image. THE FIRST REFERENCE IMAGE IS A STYLE ANCHOR ONLY. Match it for MEDIUM, BRUSHWORK, PALETTE and LIGHT QUALITY ONLY, and take NO subject from it whatsoever: none of its objects, figures, costume, props, furniture, architecture, period or location may appear in the output unless the scene description below asks for them by name. SCENE: A CLIMB INTO MORNING SKY is the subject. Vast warm dawn sky fills the frame. The winged block-tower startup climbs through its upper LEFT third, wings wide, tilted into ascent, trailing two soft paper-warm strokes; IGNORE THE SIZE AND PLACEMENT IN THE SUPPLIED PLATE, here it is airborne and one-fifth the frame's height. Far below at the bottom edge, tiny, the plain shut door stands alone in a low ordinary wall on a rooftop, rendered exactly one state, the master shut leaf, a small warm light glowing along its bottom crack. Ninety percent of the frame is sky. Keep the lower right calm for the caption card. THE CAMERA MOVES; NOTHING ELSE DOES. Every person keeps the exact seat, side and place the setting's blocking gives them, and if a BLOCKING PLATE is supplied it is the authority on who sits where: obey it at every distance. Whatever the subject is sitting at, leaning on or standing beside is STILL IN THIS PICTURE, in the near foreground if the camera is close. Everyone else present in this place is STILL PRESENT in the picture, behind or beside the subject, soft and out of focus if they are not the subject, and NOBODY leaves and NO seat empties because the camera came closer. FRAMING, WIDE: the camera is well back and the PLACE is the subject. Any figures sit inside the space at full length and no taller than half the frame, so the room, its geometry and its light all read at once. Master-first: the hero is the canonical calm, centered, face-on winged block-tower on plain terracotta. Every other use (the tilted climbing favicon, the hand-released cover, the soaring close) is derived as its own render with the locked hero passed as the first input image, never re-invented from prose. A render whose block-tower or wings disagree with the hero is a defect: regenerate from the master. Pass the correct state sheet as reference on every render (master for shut, ajar for open, museum for the hall treatment), chained off the master identity. Per-spread scenes may relocate the door into any era's wall — a dorm hallway, a city street, a museum — but the leaf design never changes: same four panels, same honey-brown wood, same brass knob on the LEFT edge as viewed. Museum plaques carry per-spread exact quoted strings baked at render time; the locked museum sheet keeps its plaque EMPTY so no string leaks across spreads. The door face itself never carries lettering in any era or state. THERE ARE NO PEOPLE AND NO CHARACTERS OF ANY KIND IN THIS IMAGE. No person, no figure, no head, no shoulder, no arm, no hand, no silhouette, no reflection of a person, and nobody seated in any chair. Any place a figure might be expected is empty. NEGATIVES: neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, glossy plastic, HUD/arc-reactor comic vocabulary, neo-comic. ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS FULL-BLEED PAINTING that fills the entire canvas edge to edge. This is NEVER a grid, NEVER a multi-panel layout, NEVER a comic page, NEVER a contact sheet, NEVER a study or turnaround sheet, NEVER a collage, and NEVER several framed views side by side. Some reference images supplied to you are multi-panel study sheets; use them ONLY for the identity and design of what they depict, and NEVER copy their panelled layout into the output. The output has exactly ONE camera, ONE moment, and NO internal borders, frames, gutters, or dividing lines of any kind. DIRECTION OF TRAVEL. If a person in this scene is moving toward something, that destination MUST BE AHEAD OF THEM IN THE FRAME and they must be seen FROM BEHIND or from three-quarters behind, so the viewer is following them into it. A figure whose face is toward the camera is walking AWAY from everything behind them: if the thing they are moving toward is drawn behind them, the picture says the opposite of the scene. Their feet, hips, shoulders and gaze all point the same way, along the direction of travel.
qa: winged-startup: The startup is a HAND-STACKED tower of two or three flat cream blocks, slightly imperfect and uneven, never a single block and never a neat machine-precise stack.
winged-startup: Cream wings are attached to the tower and the whole reads as LIFT: rising, climbing, or airborne, never sitting still on a surface.
winged-startup: Plate register only: flat solid terracotta ground, a single-weight wobbly confident black ink outline, flat ivory-cream fills as the only fills.
winged-startup: Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, UI, or cursor marks, ever.
winged-startup: Face-on and flat: no perspective, no isometric, no parallelograms, no side faces or edge thickness, no shading, no gradients, no coloured linework.
